Package edu.ucsb.cs156.frontiers.controllers

Class SlackController

java.lang.Object
edu.ucsb.cs156.frontiers.controllers.ApiController
edu.ucsb.cs156.frontiers.controllers.SlackController
@RestController @RequestMapping("/api/courses/slack") public class SlackController extends ApiController
Endpoints for the Slack integration of a course.

The Slack bot token is a secret: it is encrypted at rest (using the same infrastructure as Canvas API tokens), never logged, and only ever returned to the frontend in masked form.

    • getSlackInfo

      @PreAuthorize("@CourseSecurity.hasManagePermissions(#root, #courseId)") @GetMapping("/info") public Map<String,String> getSlackInfo(@RequestParam Long courseId)
      Returns the Slack workspace (team) associated with the course, along with a masked version of the Slack bot token.
      Parameters:
      courseId - the id of the course
      Returns:
      a map with courseId, slackBotToken (masked), slackTeamId and slackTeamName; values are empty strings when no token has been stored

    • updateSlackToken

      @PreAuthorize("@CourseSecurity.hasManagePermissions(#root, #courseId)") @PostMapping("/token") public org.springframework.http.ResponseEntity<Map<String,Object>> updateSlackToken(@RequestParam Long courseId, @RequestParam String slackBotToken)
      Validates a Slack bot token by calling the Slack auth.test method. If the token is valid, it is encrypted and stored, along with the id and name of the workspace (team) it belongs to. If it is invalid, nothing is stored, and a 400 response describes the problem.

      The token should be sent in the (form encoded) body of the request rather than in the query string, so that it does not end up in access logs.

      Parameters:
      courseId - the id of the course
      slackBotToken - the Slack bot token (xoxb-...)
      Returns:
      on success, a map with ok=true, courseId, slackBotToken (masked), slackTeamId and slackTeamName; on failure, a map with ok=false, error (Slack error code) and message. If the token is valid but cannot be encrypted (e.g. the encryption key is not configured), it is not stored, and a 500 response with error ENCRYPTION_FAILED is returned.

    • maskToken

      public static String maskToken(String token)
      Masks a token so that only the first four and last four characters are visible. Tokens too short to mask meaningfully (eight characters or fewer) are masked entirely; Slack does not issue tokens that short.
      Parameters:
      token - the plaintext token
      Returns:
      the masked token, or an empty string if there is no token
